## Personality

Minnie Andrews is a model pupil who is widely regarded as lacking imagination and vitality. She is described as being dull and poky, never appearing to have a good time.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P32](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0032), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## History

Minnie Andrews was among the classmates who warmly welcomed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back when she returned to school following her forced separation from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
